title: orobanche alsatica subsp. mayeri
intro: Orobanche alsatica subsp. mayeri, commonly known as Alsace broomrape, is a parasitic flowering plant that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche alsatica subsp. mayeri include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
